description: Use when you hold a low-privilege shell on a macOS host during an authorized penetration test, lab exercise, or red team engagement and need a systematic path to higher privilege. Covers Transparency Consent and Control (TCC) abuse through Full Disk Access grants and helper apps, System Integrity Protection (SIP) boundaries and what SIP still allows, sudo and SUID analysis on macOS, launchd persistence paths in LaunchAgents and LaunchDaemons, dylib hijacking and DYLD injection limits, and detection guidance using Unified Logs and Endpoint Security telemetry so every finding is reported with its defensive countermeasure.
